props.name: value
props.description: The checkbox's value. Identifies it within a [Checkbox Group](https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group), falling back to `name` when omitted. When submitting a form, a checked box submits `value`; with no `value`, it submits the native "on". The value the card adds to the enclosing `CheckboxGroup`'s selection. Inside a group, the group's `value` or `defaultValue` decides whether the card is checked, and the card's own `checked` and `defaultChecked` have no effect.
